items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is the biggest injury on the slate as QUESTIONABLE; affects Justin Herbert and many projections; game at 4pm ET.
items.why: Ribs injury; practiced some; Schefter confirmed Q.
items.implication: If out, major LAC WR/TE reshuffle and Herbert downgrade; if in, still monitor.
items.opportunity: Potential boost to Quentin Johnston/others if limited/out

items.text: Nico Collins listed OUT or DOUBTFUL (hamstring) for Week 2; confirmed OUT by multiple sources.
items.why: Hamstring injury from Wednesday practice; DNP Thu/Fri; history of hamstring issues.
items.implication: HOU WR room thinned; boosts remaining targets.

items.text: Zay Flowers (and Ja'Kobi Lane) OUT or DOUBTFUL; Flowers listed doubtful (hamstring).
items.why: Hamstring; limited/no practice most of week; Lane on IR/return with fractured wrist.
items.implication: BAL WR hierarchy collapses to Bateman etc.; Andrews target bump possible.
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/targets for remaining BAL WRs/TE

items.text: Brock Bowers OUT or DOUBTFUL (knee) for Week 2 vs LAC; practiced Friday but doubtful, GTD possible.
items.why: Post-meniscus trim surgery; returned to practice Friday in sleeve but listed doubtful; pregame test.
items.implication: Mayer likely sees heavy TE usage if out.
items.opportunity: Full TE role for Michael Mayer

items.text: AJ Brown on IR (high ankle); NE WR crumbs; boosts need for Henderson.
TreVeyon Henderson IN for debut; Patriots desperate for playmakers with AJ Brown IR; potential 10+ touches vs Stevenson. Nice upcoming schedule.
items.why: Ready to go; AJ Brown high-ankle on IR (4-6 weeks); NE needs explosives; matchups favorable pre-bye.
items.implication: Committee but high touch upside in debut; Stevenson share at risk.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey getting bump off Week 1 usage regardless; Kaelon Black (groin) status matters for SF RB.
items.why: Strong Week 1 usage; Black Q impacts handcuff/committee.
items.implication: Elevated CMC projection; monitor Black for any share.

items.text: Joe Burrow QUESTIONABLE (back) but said he's playing; coach indicated good to go.
items.why: Back injury; self-reported playing; listed Q officially.
items.implication: CIN offense full strength expected vs HOU (sans Collins).

items.text: Alvin Kamara listed IN; expected back and impacts Etienne.
Kenneth Walker LOVE: 74% snaps, 21/24 RB touches thru 3Q, 40% routes targeted; IND gave up 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.opportunity: High touch/target share vs soft run D

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE: 99 utilization Week 1 (tied Bijan), 19% target share recent, 25+ touches in 3 of last 4.
Bucky Irving LOVE: RB9 util, 26% target share, all RB RZ touches Week 1; CLE soft vs run; out-routed Gainwell.
Justin Jefferson LOVE: 37% tgt share from Wentz W1; 93 yds/18 PPG career w/ Wentz; CHI D soft.
DeVonta Smith LOVE (27% share, 13.7 aDOT, TEN soft); Dak Prescott LOVE (home, WAS torched, high total).
items.why: Smith volume/matchup; Dak smash spot vs weak WAS secondary, high team total.
items.opportunity: Targets for Smith; pass volume for Dak
